title: Counterexample-guided orbit refinement over symmetry-compressed templates
novelty_claim: Use the exact triangular-book verifier as an abstraction-refinement engine: start from coarse low-orbit template families, learn which pair types fail, and refine only the template dimensions implicated by those counterexamples.
closest_prior_art: Wesley-style symmetry-reduced SAT/IP search on fixed block-circulant templates, the repo's exact pair-slack repair baseline, and the now-killed fixed-old four-vertex lift.
differentiation: Unlike Paley or block-circulant reuse, the representation is not fixed in advance. Unlike pair-slack local repair, the main object being updated is the template lattice itself rather than a single edge-level witness. Unlike the frozen-old lift, it is not committed to preserving the old graph and is therefore not already refuted by the 20->21 and 21->22 infeasibility checks.
easiest_falsifier: Hold out supported cases n=20, 21, and 22, start from coarse two-block and dihedral templates, and require either recovery or a decisive template-death certificate with fewer verifier calls than the exact pair-slack baseline. If two held-out cases fail, kill the lane.
evidence_plan: Extract orbit summaries and recurring pair-saturation types from the verified witness bank through n=22.
Define a small deterministic template lattice covering two-block, dihedral, and one modest multi-orbit refinement family.
Translate verifier failures into refinement clauses and run leave-one-out recovery on held-out supported cases before touching frontier instances.
Compare verifier calls, pruned-template count, and best achieved slack against the pair-slack baseline on n=23 and n=24 only if the hold-out gate is passed.

budget_envelope.kill_switch: Stop immediately after two held-out recovery failures or after no verifier-call advantage over pair-slack on the hold-out set.

title: Deterministic exact pair-slack repair baseline
novelty_claim: Replace surrogate violation counts with a deterministic objective built from the verifier's true per-pair slack margins, using the method as a baseline-to-beat rather than as a headline novelty claim.
closest_prior_art: The repo's archived stochastic local-search family and the broader SAT/IP witness-search literature that scores candidate graphs by violations or structural surrogates.
differentiation: Its value is methodological hygiene and a fast falsifier, not a new construction family. The objective is verifier-aligned, deterministic, and easy to benchmark against the legacy surrogate score.
easiest_falsifier: On n=22, 24, and 50, require strictly better reproducible min-slack and/or fewer verifier calls than the old surrogate objective. If that does not happen, retire the lane.
evidence_plan: Freeze the exact-slack implementation and deterministic tie-breaking.
Benchmark only against the old surrogate objective on n=22, n=24, and n=50.
Treat any win as necessary but not sufficient; do not market this as novel unless it yields frontier coverage or materially smaller exact-search neighborhoods.

budget_envelope.kill_switch: Stop if the lane collapses into parameter tuning on the old heuristic family or if it fails to beat the surrogate objective cleanly.

title: Dual-shaped low-orbit seeding via coding-theory spectra
novelty_claim: Use association-scheme or MacWilliams-style dual variables to generate admissible low-orbit correlation profiles before any edge-level search, then round only those spectra that survive the exact verifier.
closest_prior_art: Paley and two-block algebraic constructions, orbit-compressed SAT search, and the repo's abandoned SDP-seeding idea.
differentiation: The proposal searches in a dual spectral space rather than directly over residues, edges, or SDP matrices. That is more novel than recycling composite-order circulant templates, but also more speculative, so it stays in reserve.
easiest_falsifier: For n=23, 24, and 50, require the rounded dual-shaped seeds to start with a strictly better slack profile or a smaller restricted search neighborhood than the current Paley-style or exact-slack seeds. If not, kill it before any large search spend.
evidence_plan: Fit dual correlation summaries to the verified witness bank and test whether they explain known witnesses better than the current cyclic templates.
Round a tiny family of admissible spectra into deterministic seeds for n=23, n=24, and n=50.
Compare initial verifier slack histograms and restricted-search dimension against the current deterministic seeds.

budget_envelope.kill_switch: Stop if the rounded seeds do not improve the initial verifier profile over existing deterministic seeds.
